decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the sensor-board power and signal input connector types and pinouts; no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE containing the SPS30 connector type, cable compatibility, supply, I2C signals, SEL connection, and ground connection.
The sensor-board connector inventory does not change the standalone USB regulator, source-selection behavior, activation condition, or powered 3.3V rail.
The source describes sensor-board connectors and does not alter the charge-status LED method, connector, signal, resistance, or population rules.
Listing 5V sensor connectors is consistent with the existing powered loads but does not change the boost converter, enable control, GPIO, current rating, or usage pattern.
The connector specification does not change the DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or role as the normal 3.3V source.
The source specifies sensor-board fanout but does not change which rails are monitored, the monitoring device, channel count, monitor position, or measurement coverage.
Assigning SDA0/SCL0 and SDA1/SCL1 to connectors does not change cable length, bus speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or conditioning topology.
The JST-PH power connector in the source is an interboard sensor-board connector, not the separate battery connector; the overlap is incidental.
The source concerns sensor-module and interboard connectors and does not alter the main-board panel button, switch, reset, touch, or BOOT interfaces.
The sensor-board connector inventory does not change the battery input range, AXP2101 power-source role, or normal-operation load coverage.
The source does not discuss the addressable LEDs, their supply, data GPIO, level shifting, or standby power control; the nearby LED message is separate from the source Event.
